<thought>To obtain the required precursors, I need the retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the reduction of a nitro group to an amine. I will search the template catalog for a forward reaction that breaks a nitro group and forms an amine, using the target molecule (the sulfonamide product inferred from the previous step) as the query. Once I have the template ID, I will apply it to the target molecule to retrieve all possible precursor combinations.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1S(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1F",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["nitro"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amine"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
